_readme: Casts for side arcs, where the usual DM plays and another player runs the game. scripts/extract_session_stats.py applies an arc to a session when that session's recap lists one of the arc's characters under Players Present ("- Player as Tex"), so a new session of the arc needs no entry here. meet_names are the speaker labels as they appear in the transcripts. Keep these characters out of the roster table in data/campaign-kb.md.
